labels.shortDescription: Relationship card: button that opens the new relationship form
labels.value: Add Relationship

labels.shortDescription: Relationship card: heading above the new relationship form
labels.value: New Relationship

labels.shortDescription: Relationship card: button that closes the form without saving
labels.value: Cancel

labels.shortDescription: Save refused: relationship on file; {0} person, {1} other, {2} record
labels.value: {0} already has this relationship with {1}. Open {2} to change it.

labels.shortDescription: Save refused: relationship on file that this user cannot see
labels.value: This relationship already exists. Ask your BarnCRM admin to look at the existing one.

labels.shortDescription: Save refused: the same relationship appears twice in one save
labels.value: The same relationship is in this save twice. Remove one of them and save again.

labels.shortDescription: Relationship card: shown when the person has no relationships yet
labels.value: Link this person to family, friends and colleagues.

labels.shortDescription: Relationship card: heading when the person has no relationships yet
labels.value: No Relationships Yet

labels.shortDescription: Relationship card: badge on a relationship that has ended
labels.value: Former

labels.shortDescription: Relationship card: the list of relationships could not be read
labels.value: BarnCRM could not read this person's relationships. Refresh the page, and if it happens again ask your BarnCRM admin to check that you can read relationships.

labels.shortDescription: Relationship card: what a screen reader hears while the card loads
labels.value: Loading relationships

labels.shortDescription: Relationship card: the card heading
labels.value: Relationships

labels.shortDescription: Save refused: both contact and account lookup filled in for one person
labels.value: A relationship names one record for each person. Fill in either the person or the person account on each side, not both.

labels.shortDescription: Save refused: one of the two people is missing
labels.value: A relationship needs a person on each side.

labels.shortDescription: Relationship card: button that deletes one relationship and its other side
labels.value: Remove

labels.shortDescription: Relationship card: the relationship could not be deleted
labels.value: BarnCRM could not remove that relationship. Check that you can delete relationships, and if it happens again ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.

labels.shortDescription: Relationship card: confirmation after both sides are deleted
labels.value: Relationship removed from both people.

labels.shortDescription: Save refused: the two sides name the same person
labels.value: A relationship needs two different people.

labels.shortDescription: Relationship card: the new relationship could not be saved
labels.value: That relationship could not be saved. Check the message on the form and try again.

labels.shortDescription: Relationship card: confirmation after a relationship is saved
labels.value: Relationship saved, and the other person's record now shows it too.

labels.shortDescription: Save refused: the other side of the relationship could not be written
labels.value: BarnCRM could not update the other side of this relationship, so nothing was saved. The Error Log has the details.

labels.shortDescription: Stands in for a person's name in a message when the name cannot be read
labels.value: this person
